confidence_note: Checked against book text (Love Everything That Happens). Old claims dropped: "Dec 1914" (not in the passage), "$23M damage" (book: loss almost $1M, about $23M in today's dollars) and the "all our mistakes are burned" quote (not in the book).
facts: Age 67, Edison went home early; after dinner a man rushed in: fire at his research and production campus a few miles away.
Engines from eight towns could not contain it; chemicals fed green and yellow flames six and seven stories high.
He found his son and said with childlike excitement: get your mother and her friends, they will never see a fire like this again; "We've just got rid of a lot of rubbish."
Years of records, prototypes, research turned to ash; supposedly fireproof concrete buildings insured for about a third of the damage.
Next day told a reporter he was not too old for a fresh start; "prevents a man from being afflicted with ennui."
Within about three weeks partly running; within a month two shifts a day with new products.
Loss almost $1M (more than $23M today) yet nearly $10M revenue that year.
Holiday: weeping or quitting would accomplish nothing; earlier in book Edison tested six thousand filaments in 1878.
scene_details: get your mother and her friends
tension: A man watching decades of work burn behaves as if it were a spectacle.
opening_idea: Open on the flames and the errand he gave his son.

lessons.idea: After a loss, give the first job to the next step.
lessons.anchor: Edison talked of a fresh start the next day and had the factory partly running in three weeks.
lessons.everyday_example_idea: A shopkeeper after a flood lists which shelves could open tomorrow.

reflect_final: After the last big setback you had, what did you first have to put down before you could move on to the next step?

use_cases.move: Postpone the post-mortem, list what remains today.

use_cases.situation: A plan at home is ruined.
use_cases.move: Ask what can be working again tomorrow.
Cite Edison's three weeks and ask what you can return to today.

pocket_idea: Before tallying damage, write tomorrow's first job.

conversation_variants.punchline_idea: While his factory burned, Edison sent for his mother and her friends because they would never see such a fire again.
conversation_variants.thirty_sec_idea: Edison at 67 watched his campus burn, insured for a third; three weeks later it was partly running. Holiday: nothing else would have accomplished anything.
